main_text.p: בַּר Chald. Filius: לְבַר Filio, Dan. 3. 25. בַּר Quasi filius, verf.31. בַּר Filius ejus, Daniel. 5.22. Et sic Hebraicè, בְּשָׁקוּ בַר Osculamini Filium, Psalm. 2. v.12. Aff. בְּרִי Fili mi, Proverb. 31.2. Ex hoc loco Aben Esra precedentem exponit, בַּר scil. utrobiq; eodem sensu sumi, quia scriptum est, בְּנִי אַתָּה Filius meus es tu. Item, Osculandi verbum hic denotare Osculum subjectionis & obedientiæ, ut etiamnum (inquit) moris est apud Indos. Aliam significationem vide in בָּרַר.

בָּרָא m. Chald. Ager: חֵיַּת בָּרָא Bestia agri, Dan. 2.v.38. בְּדְתָּאָא דִּי בָרָא In herba agri, Dan. 4. v.12. Est à בַּר Foris, Extra, quod in Targum ponitur pro Hebraeo חוּץ, & inde est Ager, proprie Inculcus & sylvestris, extra limites agrorum cultorum situs; unde תּוֹר בַּר Bos agrestis sive sylvestris.

בָּרָא Creavit, ac proprie Deo competit, Gen. 1.1. Niph. נִבְרָא Creari, Recreari: Præt. נִבְרְאוּ Creantur, Jes. 48.7. Part. נִבְרָא Creatus vel Recreatus & renovatus, Psal. 102.19. Fut. יִבָּרְאוּן Recreantur, Renovantur, Ps. 104. v.30. Pih. בֵּרֵא Præcidit, Exscidit, Succidit: Item, Elegit, Selegit, quæ ex significatione Verbi בָּרַר & בָּרָה manare videntur: Præt. וּבְרָאתָ Et succidit, Josh. 17.15. בְּרָאתוֹ Exscinde eam, v.18. Infin. וּבְרָא אוֹתָהֶן Etiam succidendo eas, Ezech. 23.47. Imp. וַיַּד בָּרָא Et latus seliges[?], Ezech. 21. v.19. Hiph. הִבְרִיא Saginare, ex Nomine derivato. Infin. לְהַבְרִיאֲכֶם Ut saginaretis vos, 1.Sam. 2.29.

בְּרִיא m. Pinguis, Saginatus, Jud. 3.17. Plural. בְּרִיאִים Saginati, 1.Reg. 4.23. cum defectu Jod in medio: Constr. בְּרִיאֵי Dan. 1.15. Fœmin. בְּרִיאָה Pingue, Opimum, Ezech. 34.3. vel defectivè, בְּרָאָה, Hab. 1.16. Plur. בְּרִיאוֹת Pingues, Genes. 41.2.5. Et substantivè, בְּרִיאָה Creatura, Creatio, Num. 16.30.

page.notes: Lemma letters are the Hebrew headwords, set larger than the text. The running head and some Hebrew forms are hard to read and are marked [?]. "Inculcus" and "seliges" are uncertain readings. Hebrew vowel points are copied as far as they can be seen.
